capabilities: Convert selected text between Latin, Cyrillic and phonetic Uzbek scripts, with auto-detection
Spell-check the current document against a built-in dictionary of 1000+ Uzbek words
Add custom words to the dictionary via right-click menu or by editing a Markdown file
Show a configurable startup popup with quotes from Uzbek classics
disambiguation: Not a general writing or prose assistant; it only provides Uzbek script conversion, spell checking, and a quote popup.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; documentation is provided in English, Uzbek and Russian.
problem: Obsidian has no Uzbek spell-check dictionary and no tool for converting Uzbek text between its official Latin and Cyrillic alphabets.
summary: Uzbek language toolkit that converts text between Latin, Cyrillic and phonetic scripts, spell-checks against an Uzbek dictionary, and shows a daily quote.
